title: PARALLAX and DREAMSTATE V2 evidence science upgrade
summary: PARALLAX V2 now binds action/regime/comparison contracts into immutable decision identity, requires evidence-complete paired paths, isolates source revisions/contracts/branch parameters, adds context strata, richer target/compound twins, non-pooled regret, and Benjamini-Hochberg FDR screening. DREAMSTATE V2 consumes only candidate-ready PARALLAX signals, isolates families by revision/contract, adds target and compound hypotheses, policy contracts, family search accounting, source-decay retirement, and stronger gate preconditions. All authority remains research/shadow only.
evidence: comparison-contract identity and backward-compatible SQLite migration
paired evidence completeness and branch-parameter isolation
Benjamini-Hochberg FDR screen within exact evidence families
regret and ablation isolation by comparable evidence scope
one active candidate per family and 12-trial budget
